Data and credits

This applicant prototype reuses the existing RSA form fields, 2026/27 allowance values, evidence periods, and user-supplied journal ranking datasets. These have not been revalidated against a new application round. It does not assess eligibility or make award recommendations.

Publications can be read from the ORCID public API and enriched with Crossref DOI metadata. BibTeX and application files are processed in the browser. Device draft saving is optional and off by default. Excel, JSON, and CSV files are generated locally and downloaded to your device. Excel export uses the bundled ExcelJS 4.4.0 library (MIT license in vendor/ExcelJS-LICENSE). No application is submitted to the university by this prototype.

AJG 2024 uses the supplied CABS dataset. SJR scores and quartiles use the supplied SJR dataset (built in May 2026). Journal matches use exact ISSNs where available, then normalized titles. A journal rating is not an output-specific REF assessment.

APA formatting uses citeproc-js (license) and the unmodified APA CSL style by Brenton M. Wiernik and Andrew Dunning under CC BY-SA 3.0. BibTeX parsing uses Citation.js (MIT license).
